svg.title: EQUAL EARTH ocean projection prototype
svg.desc: The EQUAL EARTH candidate projects the same schematic OSW heat reservoirs, transient anomaly, currents, and Antarctic Circumpolar Current over checksum-pinned Natural Earth coastlines. Heatmass areas read clearly; the Africa seam still splits polar water.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth 1:110m land, public domain, commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19, SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson. Projection rendering and conceptual overlays are original MIT-licensed OSW work. PELAGOS is an experimental aspect of Lambert azimuthal equal-area, not a new projection equation.
svg.text: Heatmass areas read clearly; the Africa seam still splits polar water.
Same schematic features · same coastline source · projection changes only
